note: a qualified row is one whose identical test exposed the violation on the pinned vulnerable revision and passed on the pinned fixed revision; candidates, runs and tasks are counted apart

qualification_requirements.repository: source provenance: an immutable repository URL
qualification_requirements.stage_decision: the grader's own stage reached, not a process exit code
qualification_requirements.test_sha256: one identical test file, hashed, on both sides
qualification_requirements.toolchain: compiler and runner versions used for both runs
